response.overview: Super Bowl LVIII, played on February 11, 2024, at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas, Nevada, saw the Kansas City Chiefs defeat the San Francisco 49ers 25-22 in overtime, securing their third Super Bowl title in five seasons and becoming the first team in nearly two decades to win back-to-back championships. The Chiefs’ victory was a testament to their championship resilience, a clutch performance by quarterback Patrick Mahomes, and a defense that bent but never broke in the game’s most critical moments.
response.tagline: Kansas City Chiefs vs. San Francisco 49ers
response.title: Super Bowl LVIII
